blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — Quezon’s “Sunggod Teh Kamanga” festival bagged Best Cultural Festival at Bukidnon’s Pagdayaw: A Night of Tourism, Culture, and Arts Excellence. Sunggod Teh Kamanga is a vibrant showcase of the Manobo tribe’s traditions and culture, uniting the community to honor and preserve their heritage.
